title: Interesting Update for Intel Stock Investors | INTC Stock Deep Dive Part 3
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate updates his Intel thesis after the stock fell more than 50% from its all-time high earlier in 2026. The core positive is manufacturing: Nova Lake, the first Intel 18A client product, is tracking ahead of schedule with design wins expected at twice Panther Lake's at launch, and Intel 3 and 18A yields are improving, 18A at a double-digit rate, with wafer output above expectations. He argues agentic AI is lifting demand for data-centre CPUs, Intel's strong suit, and cites Intel's estimate that the server CPU total addressable market could grow fivefold, from $40bn to over $200bn in five years, with consumer agentic AI (Meta Muse passed 10 million downloads in its first month) still to come. The big open opportunity is external foundry customers: Intel has idle capacity and strategic engagements, but has not yet won those customers from TSMC, and it remains far behind in GPUs. Headcount has been cut by roughly 25,000-30,000 to under 90,000. On valuation, forward P/E is 32, down from 80 earlier in the year, and his DCF fair value is $51.37 against a $57.32 price, so he calls Intel fairly valued and reiterates HOLD; around $45 would make it undervalued. Call: INTC HOLD @ $57.32 (reiterated).
